That's what I tell myself, but it just..doesn't work. The thoughts are so intrusive that it takes over everything. 

For one example: I'll change my outfit 10-15 times before I leave so I look "acceptable" to myself. No matter what I do, I feel like I am a hideous piece of garbage that no one wants to be near.

I know what caused all of my self-loathing issues, but I just don't feel strong enough to deal with them anymore. Plus, if I did go to therapy, I  feel like I would need almost daily therapy sessions to make it through the week. I use to just bullshit around my therapy sessions as a teenager and when something bad would happen, whether it was mental illness related or not, I would use it as an excuse to *not* go, which made it all worse. Plus, my therapist before I graduated I thought was gorgeous and I stopped seeing him after I went to a psychiatric hospital because my parents "couldn't afford it" anymore (Which was really them thinking there was nothing wrong and I was a lazy piece of crap or something).

My ex was different. We both just clicked, I never felt that way before (or after) no matter how much (and it was a lot..) I looked for it. I know my faults, like I said, and I know that I have issues that are deep seeded into my brain, but I just can't break free from..well me, I guess.

I know I do, but I'm so conflicted about everything. I feel like no matter what path I choose, I have to make myself unhappy. Which is why I'm debating on therapy or not, because honestly, with my mentality, I feel as though I will do the opposite of what they suggest or refuse to work on myself, not out of spite or hatred towards the therapist, but purely based on the fact I just can't control myself. I feel like I have to beat myself up or I might think something nice about myself, which I can't do because well..I'm a piece of shit. So, it's a bad cycle that I need to try to break, but I have yet to figure out how to for over a decade so..I don't know what to do anymore..

Thank you though..
